books.title: Hello, Butterfly
books.art_why: Butterflies are real animals that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A large butterfly with wide open wings rests on a broad green leaf in a sunny garden. Its wings are spread flat, showing smooth patterns and delicate edges. Soft light falls around it, and the leaf fills much of the frame.

A tiny butterfly sits near the center of a small white flower in a garden. Its wings are closed slightly above its back, and its thin body looks light against the petals. Green stems and soft background leaves surround it.

A red butterfly rests on a green leaf in a garden. Its red wings are open and clearly visible, with fine dark edges along the sides. The leaf is broad and flat beneath it, and sunlight brightens the nearby plants.

A green butterfly stands on a slender stem in a garden. Its green wings blend closely with the leaves around it, and its small body is angled toward a flower. Soft daylight touches the plant and the clear background.

A striped butterfly rests with open wings on a flat green leaf. Dark bands run across its pale wings, making a clear striped pattern. The leaf sits among other green plants, and soft outdoor light falls across the scene.

A spotted butterfly rests on a flower in a garden. Round dark spots stand out on its open wings, which are held flat in the light. Petals and green leaves surround the butterfly, with a soft, uncluttered background behind it.

A freshly emerged butterfly rests on a leaf in a garden. Its wings look whole and bright, held open in the soft light. The leaf is clean and green beneath it, and nearby plants stay softly out of focus.

A butterfly rests on a bright flower in a garden, wings open and facing forward. Its patterned wings catch the light, and the flower sits among green leaves. The background is soft and open, with space around the butterfly.

books.title: Muscles
books.art_why: Muscles and children’s actions are real-world subjects that photographs can show.

pages.brief: A young child jumps straight up with knees bent and arms swinging, showing the leg and arm muscles working, in a plain open space with no extra objects. The child’s face is focused and happy, and the whole body is caught mid-air.

A young child runs forward with bent elbows and strong legs, showing the leg muscles at work, in a plain open space with no extra objects. The child leans slightly into the run, one foot forward and one foot back, with a determined, cheerful expression.

A young child pushes both palms forward with straight arms, leaning into the motion, showing arm and shoulder muscles working, in a plain open space with no extra objects. The child’s feet are planted, and the face shows effort and concentration.

A young child lifts both arms upward with elbows slightly bent, showing arm and shoulder muscles working, in a plain open space with no extra objects. The child stands tall, feet steady, and looks up with a proud, focused expression.

A young child stretches both arms high overhead and reaches up, showing long back and arm muscles, in a plain open space with no extra objects. The child stands with feet apart, body lengthened, and a calm, open expression.

A young child pulls both hands toward the chest with bent elbows, leaning back slightly, showing arm and back muscles working, in a plain open space with no extra objects. The child’s feet are planted, and the face shows steady effort.

A young child kicks one leg forward with a straight knee and pointed foot, showing leg muscles working, in a plain open space with no extra objects. The child balances on the other foot with arms out slightly and a focused expression.

A young child smiles broadly, cheeks lifted and eyes bright, showing the face muscles that make a smile, in a plain open space with no extra objects. The child faces forward with a happy, relaxed expression.

books.title: Going Places
books.art_why: Real vehicles and everyday transport exist today.

pages.text: You can go on a plane.
pages.brief: A young child sits by the window inside a passenger plane, looking out at fluffy clouds. The plane flies high above the ground, with sky all around and distant land far below. The child looks happy and ready for a trip.

pages.text: You can go on a train.
pages.brief: A young child sits by the window on a train, watching the countryside pass by. The train travels along tracks through green fields and trees, carrying passengers to a new place. Sunlight fills the train car.

pages.text: You can go on a boat.
pages.brief: A young child stands on the deck of a small boat, looking out over calm blue water. The boat floats gently, with soft waves around it and open sky above. The child wears a life jacket.

pages.text: You can go in a car.
pages.brief: A young child sits in the back seat of a car, looking out the window. The car drives along a road past houses and trees, taking the child to a new place. The seat belt is fastened.

pages.text: You can go in a bus.
pages.brief: A young child sits on a bus, looking out at the town going by. The bus rolls along the street with other passengers aboard, heading toward a stop. The child holds a small backpack near the window.

pages.text: You can go on a bike.
pages.brief: A young child rides a bike along a paved path in a park, holding the handlebars. The bike moves forward with trees and grass on either side. The child wears a helmet and smiles brightly.

pages.text: You can go on a skateboard.
pages.brief: A young child rides a skateboard along a smooth path in a park, knees bent and arms out for balance. The skateboard rolls forward past trees and grass. The child wears a helmet and knee pads.

pages.text: You can go on a horse.
pages.brief: A young child sits on a horse in a grassy field, holding the reins. The horse stands calmly with trees and open sky in the background. The child smiles and looks ahead, ready for a ride.

books.title: My Body
books.art_why: Real body parts and a child can be photographed directly.

pages.brief: A young child stands against a plain, bright background and shows one bare foot. The foot is the clear focus, with toes and ankle visible. The child stands safely on a simple floor, and the pose is calm and natural so the foot is easy to see.

A young child stands against a plain, bright background and shows one leg. The leg is the clear focus, from hip to ankle, with the shape easy to see. The child stands safely on a simple floor, and the pose is calm and natural for a simple body-parts picture.

A young child stands against a plain, bright background and shows one bare belly. The belly is the clear focus, with the middle of the body visible. The child stands safely on a simple floor, and the pose is calm and natural so the belly is easy to see.

A young child stands against a plain, bright background and shows the chest. The chest is the clear focus, with the upper front of the body visible. The child stands safely on a simple floor, and the pose is calm and natural so the chest is easy to see.

A young child stands against a plain, bright background and shows one hand. The hand is the clear focus, with fingers and palm clearly visible. The child holds the hand up calmly, and the background stays plain so the hand is easy to see.

A young child stands against a plain, bright background and shows one arm. The arm is the clear focus, from shoulder to wrist, with its shape easy to see. The child stands safely on a simple floor, and the pose is calm and natural for a simple body-parts picture.

A young child stands against a plain, bright background and shows the head. The head is the clear focus, with its shape clearly visible. The child stands safely on a simple floor, and the pose is calm and natural so the head is easy to see.

A young child stands against a plain, bright background and shows the whole body. The full body is the clear focus, from head to feet. The child stands safely on a simple floor, and the pose is calm and natural so the whole body is easy to see.

books.title: How Many in All?
books.art_why: Counting objects such as bears, rings, dogs, and jacks are real items that can be photographed.

pages.text: There are three blue bears. There are three green bears.
pages.brief: Three blue bears are grouped together on one side, and three green bears are grouped together beside them. All six bears are clearly visible, with nothing else in the scene, so a child can count each color group.

A group of bears is shown together in one clear view. The bears are all visible at once, with no other animals around, so a young reader can count every bear and answer how many bears there are in all.

pages.text: There are four thin rings. There are three thick rings.
pages.brief: Four thin rings are placed in one group, and three thick rings are placed in another group. The rings are shown clearly, with their thin and thick shapes easy to compare, so a child can count each set.
A group of rings is shown together in one clear view. All the rings are visible at once, with space around them, so a young reader can count every ring and answer how many rings there are in all.

pages.text: There are four sitting dogs. There are five standing dogs.
pages.brief: Four dogs are sitting in one group, and five dogs are standing in another group. All the dogs are clearly visible, with their sitting and standing positions easy to see, ready for a child to count.
A clear group of dogs fills the scene, all visible at once and ready to be counted together. The dogs are shown together in one view so a young reader can count how many dogs there are in all.

A collection of jacks is shown together in one clear group. The jacks are all visible at once, with space around them, so a young reader can count the jacks and answer how many jacks there are in all.

books.title: Go Fly a Kite
books.art_why: Kites and outdoor skies are real-world subjects that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A fish-shaped kite flies high in a clear sky, its body painted like a fish with fins and a tail. The kite tilts in the breeze, trailing a long ribbon tail behind it, alone above the open air.
A plane-shaped kite soars in the sky, shaped like a small airplane with wings and a tail. It banks gently in the wind, its long tail streaming behind, high above the open ground.
A shark-shaped kite floats in the sky, with a pointed nose, fins and a tail. Its body is grey and white, and it hangs in the breeze with a long tail trailing below, high above the open air.
A bird-shaped kite flies in the open sky, with wide wings, a rounded head and a tail. The kite spreads its wings in the breeze, a long ribbon tail trailing behind it, high above the ground.
A boat-shaped kite sails in the sky, shaped like a small boat with a hull and a sail. It leans gently in the wind, a long tail streaming behind, floating high above the open air.

A brightly coloured butterfly-shaped kite flies in the sky, with wide patterned wings and a small body. It floats in the breeze, its long tail trailing behind, high above the open air with its wings spread wide.

A dragon-shaped kite rises in the sky, with a long body, small wings and a curled tail. It twists in the breeze, a long ribbon tail trailing behind, high above the open air, its dragon head facing forward.

A rainbow-coloured kite flies in the sky, its wide arc striped in bright colours. It floats gently in the breeze, a long tail streaming behind, high above the open air, bright and clear against the open sky.

books.title: Getting Dressed
books.art_why: A present-day child dressing is a real, everyday scene a camera can capture.

pages.brief: A young child stands in a bright bedroom, holding a shirt with both hands and pulling it over the head, one arm already through a sleeve. The shirt is half on, bunched at the shoulders, as the child works to get dressed.
The same young child sits on the edge of a bed, lifting one leg and sliding it into a pair of pants held at the waist. The pants are partway up, and the child's bare feet reach toward the floor.
The child stands beside the bed with pants now on, threading a belt through the loops at the waist. Both small hands hold the belt, one end pushed through, the buckle hanging loose in front.
Sitting on the floor, the child bends forward and pulls a sock onto one foot, thumbs stretching the opening wide. The other sock waits nearby on the floor, and the child's shoes sit to one side.
The child sits on a low chair, pressing a foot down into a shoe and pushing the heel in with one hand. The second shoe waits on the floor beside the first, ready to go on next.
The child stands and lifts a pair of glasses to the face, holding the arms with both hands and settling them over the ears. The child's eyes look forward, glasses now resting on the nose.
With arms swung back, the child pushes one arm and then the other into a jacket, the fabric sliding up over the shoulders. The jacket hangs open at the front, not yet zipped.
The child stands ready by a door, turning to slip one arm and then the other through a backpack's straps. The backpack settles against the child's back, and the child's hands hold the straps.

books.title: Athletes
books.art_why: Athletes are real people in the present day.

pages.brief: A group of athletes run together in an open sports area. Their arms are bent and their legs are stretched as they move forward. One athlete is slightly ahead, and the others follow close behind. The picture focuses only on the athletes running.

Two athletes are kicking in a sports area, one leg lifted and swinging forward. Their arms help them balance as they make the kicking motion. A third athlete stands nearby, also focused on kicking. The scene shows only the kicking action.

Several athletes are swimming in a pool of water. Their heads are above the water, and their arms reach forward as they swim. One athlete is beside another, both moving through the water. The picture shows only athletes swimming, with no diving or other sport.

An athlete dives into water with arms stretched forward and body angled downward. The diver is above the water for a moment before entering it. Another athlete waits nearby at the edge of the water. The picture shows the diving action clearly, with only athletes and water.

An athlete throws with one arm pulled back and then extended forward in a sports area. The thrower's body twists with the motion. Another athlete stands nearby, watching the throw. The picture focuses on the throwing action and the athletes, with no other activity shown.

An athlete rides on a bicycle in a sports area, hands on the handlebars and body leaning forward. The wheels turn as the rider moves along. Another athlete rides behind on a second bicycle. The picture shows only athletes riding, with the riding action clear.

Several athletes row in a boat on water, each holding an oar and pulling it back together. The boat moves across the water as the rowers work in rhythm. The athletes sit in a line, facing the direction of travel. The picture shows only rowing athletes and water.

A group of athletes celebrate winning in a sports area. They raise their arms, smile and cheer together after their effort. One athlete stands in front with a happy, proud expression. The picture shows the winning moment with only athletes and their celebration.

books.title: Spring and Fall
books.art_why: Leaves, birds, corn and a child are all real, everyday things a camera can show.

pages.brief: A close view of fresh green leaves opening on a tree branch, soft and new in spring light. The leaves fill most of the picture, some still curled, some already spread flat, pale green tips and thin stems joining them to the twig.

Leaves on the same kind of branch now turned yellow, orange and red, some still attached and a few falling through the air. Cooler autumn light, bare twigs showing where leaves have already dropped away.

Small birds perched on a leafy branch in spring, beaks open, feathers neat, one bird holding a wisp of grass for a nest. Green leaves around them, soft daylight, the birds close and clearly shaped in the frame.

A flock of birds high in the sky in fall, flying together in a loose group, wings spread, moving across the frame. Pale autumn sky behind them, a few drifting leaves lower down, the birds small but clearly shaped.

Young corn plants in a field in spring, short green stalks in straight rows, leaves fresh and upright, dark damp soil between them. Low view along the rows in soft spring sunlight, with no cobs on the plants yet.

Tall corn in fall, dry stalks and yellowing leaves, ripe cobs in their husks on the stems. The field is golden and crowded, rows running deep, late-afternoon light, the plants much taller and browner than in spring.

A young child standing outdoors in spring, wearing a short-sleeved top, on grass with green leaves nearby. The child faces the viewer and smiles, arms relaxed, soft spring light, shown clearly from the waist up.
The same young child outdoors in fall, now in a warm jacket, standing on grass with cheeks pink from the cool air. The child smiles at the viewer, thinning bare branches and autumn light behind them.

books.title: Grandparents Are Great!
books.art_why: Grandparents doing everyday activities are real people who can be photographed.

pages.brief: A smiling grandmother and grandfather stand together in a bright home kitchen, cooking a simple meal. One stirs a pot while the other sets out bowls. Warm light, everyday clothes, and a calm, friendly scene show grandparents enjoying cooking together.

A grandmother and grandfather swim together in a clear swimming pool, moving through the water with happy faces. One floats on the surface while the other swims nearby. Bright daylight and blue water fill the scene, showing grandparents enjoying a calm swim.

Two grandparents hike along a woodland trail, walking side by side with steady steps. One carries a small backpack while the other looks ahead. Trees and soft outdoor light surround them, showing grandparents enjoying a healthy hike together in nature.

A grandfather and grandmother golf on a grassy course, each holding a golf club and standing near a small ball. One prepares to swing while the other watches. Green grass and open sky fill the background, showing grandparents enjoying a relaxed game of golf.

A grandmother sits at a sewing table, guiding fabric through a sewing machine with careful hands. A grandfather stands nearby, watching her work. Spools of thread and simple tools rest on the table, showing grandparents enjoying sewing in a comfortable home setting.

A grandfather and grandmother garden together in a sunny backyard, kneeling beside small plants. One pulls weeds while the other waters the soil. Green plants and soft daylight surround them, showing grandparents enjoying gardening with calm, careful hands.

A grandmother and grandfather paint at a wooden easel, each holding a brush and working on a colorful picture. One steps back to look while the other adds paint. Simple art supplies and bright light fill the room, showing grandparents enjoying painting together.

A grandfather and grandmother sit together in cozy chairs, each holding an open book. One turns a page while the other reads quietly. Soft light and a calm room surround them, showing grandparents enjoying reading side by side.

books.title: This Insect
books.art_why: Real insects exist today and can be photographed.

pages.brief: A single insect with a thick, powerful body stands firmly in a clear outdoor space. Its sturdy legs and broad frame make it look strong. The insect fills the center of the scene, shown close enough to see its solid shape and confident stance.

A single insect with a sleek body races through a clear outdoor space. Its legs are stretched mid-run and its whole shape leans forward, making it look fast. The insect is centered in the scene, shown close enough to see its quick, forward movement.

A single insect covered in soft, fuzzy hair rests in a clear outdoor space. Its furry body and tiny hairs are easy to see, making it look furry. The insect is centered in the scene, shown close enough to reveal its thick, textured coat.

A single insect with a very thin body and long, slender legs stands in a clear outdoor space. Its narrow shape makes it look skinny. The insect is centered in the scene, shown close enough to see its slim outline and delicate legs.

A single insect with a smooth, glossy shell sits in a clear outdoor space. Bright highlights shine along its back, making it look shiny. The insect is centered in the scene, shown close enough to see the gleam on its hard outer body.

A single insect with clear round spots on its body rests in a clear outdoor space. The spots stand out against its color, making it look spotted. The insect is centered in the scene, shown close enough to see each mark on its back and sides.

A single insect with bold bands across its body stands in a clear outdoor space. The stripes run along its back and sides, making it look striped. The insect is centered in the scene, shown close enough to see the clear lines and contrasting colors.

A single insect with bright colors and fine details rests in a clear outdoor space. Its vivid body and graceful shape make it look beautiful. The insect is centered in the scene, shown close enough to see its colors, texture, and delicate form.

books.title: For Mom
books.art_why: A real child and mother doing everyday things at home exist in the real world today.

pages.brief: A young boy sits at a small table with crayons scattered around, drawing a bright picture on paper. A woman stands beside him, looking down at the drawing with a warm smile in a cozy room.
In a sunny kitchen, a young boy stands on a step stool stirring a bowl on the counter, wearing an apron. A woman stands nearby, watching him cook with a happy, encouraging smile.
A young boy stands in a living room singing with his mouth open wide, one hand raised. A woman sits on the sofa listening, smiling warmly at him as he sings for her.
A young boy holds a cloth and wipes a low wooden table in a tidy, bright room, bending down to clean the surface carefully. A woman stands in the doorway watching him help, pleased and smiling.
A young boy grips a full bag with both hands, walking carefully across a room with steady steps. A woman walks beside him, watching with a grateful smile as he carries the load for her.
A young boy stands in a bright, sunlit room and looks straight ahead with a big, happy smile, showing his teeth. A woman nearby smiles back at him, her face warm and pleased.
A young boy sits on a soft sofa holding an open picture book, reading with his eyes on the pages. A woman sits beside him, listening to him read with a proud, gentle smile.
A young boy lies in bed with a soft pillow and a blanket pulled up to his chin, eyes closed and peaceful. A woman stands at the door, watching him sleep quietly in the dim room.

books.title: Dad and I
books.art_why: Real-world father and child activities today; a photo fits.

pages.brief: Dad and his young child bake together in a home kitchen. The child stands close to Dad, watching and helping with the baking. Dad guides the child, and both are focused on the shared baking activity. The scene feels warm and simple, showing the two of them working side by side.

Dad and his young child swim together in a pool. Dad is in the water with the child nearby, both enjoying the swim. The child looks toward Dad as they move through the water. The scene focuses on the two of them sharing a safe, happy swimming activity.

Dad and his young child garden together outdoors. Dad and the child work close to the plants, each helping with the gardening. The child stays near Dad while they tend the garden. The scene is calm and bright, centered on the two of them sharing the gardening work.

Dad and his young child play together in a play area. The child is near Dad, both engaged in the same playful activity. Dad stays with the child as they play, and the child looks happy and involved. The scene focuses on the two of them enjoying playtime together.

Dad and his young child bike together outdoors. Dad and the child ride side by side on a path, both focused on biking. The child stays close to Dad while they bike along. The scene is active and bright, showing the two of them sharing the ride.

Dad and his young child walk together outdoors. Dad and the child move side by side along a path, both walking at an easy pace. The child stays near Dad during the walk. The scene is calm and simple, centered on the two of them sharing a walk.

Dad and his young child write together at a table. Dad and the child sit close, each focused on writing. The child works beside Dad, and both are quiet and engaged. The scene is warm and simple, showing the two of them sharing the writing activity.

Dad and his young child hug closely. Dad holds the child in a warm hug, and the child hugs Dad back. They stand together in a quiet, happy moment. The scene focuses on the two of them and the closeness of their hug.

books.title: Where to Go
books.art_why: All destinations are real places or objects that can be photographed.

pages.brief: The picture shows a playground as the place to go. The view focuses on the playground setting, with open space and play equipment, presented clearly so young readers can recognise the destination and understand where to go.

The picture shows a pool as the place to go. The view focuses on the pool itself, with calm water and the pool setting presented clearly so young readers can recognise the destination and understand where to go next.

The picture shows the woods as the place to go. The view focuses on the woods setting, with trees and a clear natural area presented simply so young readers can recognise the destination and understand where to go.

The picture shows a museum as the place to go. The view focuses on the museum building and its setting, presented clearly and simply so young readers can recognise the destination and understand where to go.

The picture shows the beach as the place to go. The view focuses on the beach setting, with sand and sea presented clearly and simply so young readers can recognise the destination and understand where to go.

The picture shows a game as the place to go. The view focuses on the game setting, with a field and the sporting event presented clearly so young readers can recognise the destination and understand where to go.

The picture shows a parade as the place to go. The view focuses on the parade setting, with a street and the parade passing through, presented clearly so young readers can recognise the destination and understand where to go.

The picture shows a bed as the place to go. The view focuses on the bed and the bedroom setting, presented clearly and simply so young readers can recognise the destination and understand where to go at the end.

books.title: Christmas Cookies
books.art_why: Cookies are real everyday objects that can be photographed.

pages.brief: Star-shaped cookies are shown being made, each one cut into a clear five-point star. The star cookies sit together as a group, with their neat edges and simple shape easy to see. The focus stays on the star cookies and the making step.

Bell-shaped cookies are shown being made, each cookie shaped like a small bell. The bell cookies rest together in a group, with rounded tops and widened bottoms clearly visible. The picture keeps attention on the bell cookie shapes and the making of them.

Snowflake-shaped cookies are shown being made, each cookie formed with thin arms spreading out like a snowflake. The snowflake cookies sit together in a set, with their delicate shapes easy to see. The focus stays on the snowflake cookies and the making step.

Tree-shaped cookies are shown being made, each cookie cut into a simple evergreen tree shape. The tree cookies rest together as a group, with pointed tops and layered branches easy to see. The picture focuses only on the tree cookies and the making of them.

Flower-shaped cookies are shown being made, each cookie formed with rounded petals around a center. The flower cookies sit together in a set, with their petal shapes clear and simple. The focus stays on the flower cookies and the making step.

Snowman-shaped cookies are shown being made, each cookie formed with stacked round sections like a snowman. The snowman cookies rest together as a group, with their simple outlines clearly visible. The picture keeps attention on the snowman cookie shapes and the making of them.

Candle-shaped cookies are shown being made, each cookie formed like a straight candle with a small flame shape at the top. The candle cookies sit together in a set, with their simple outlines easy to see. The focus stays on the candle cookies and the making step.

Santa-shaped cookies are shown being made, each cookie formed like a cheerful Santa figure. The Santa cookies rest together as a group, with their simple shapes and details easy to see. The picture focuses only on the Santa cookies and the making of them.

books.title: Time for Eggs
books.art_why: Eggs, collecting, cleaning, cooking and eating are real-world activities that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A close, clear view shows several whole eggs in a simple, plain setting, ready to be found. The eggs are the only focus, with no extra people or objects, so young readers can look at them and understand what they are searching for.

The whole eggs are shown gathered together in one place, as if they have just been collected. The picture keeps the focus on the eggs themselves, with a simple background and no extra people or objects beyond the eggs.

The eggs are shown held together and moving carefully from one place to another, as if being carried. The view stays close on the eggs, with a plain background, so the carrying action is simple for young readers to follow.

Several eggs are arranged in a clear row so they can be counted one by one. The focus is only on the eggs and their number, with no people or extra objects, making the counting action easy for young readers to see.

The eggs are shown being gently cleaned, with a simple wipe or rinse, while the focus stays on the eggs. The setting is plain and uncluttered, so young readers can see the cleaning step clearly without any extra people or objects.

The eggs are shown being cracked open, with the shells breaking and the inside coming out. The view stays close on the eggs and the cracking action, with a plain background and no extra people or objects beyond what is needed to show the step.

The cracked eggs are shown cooking, changing as they heat, with the focus only on the eggs. The background is simple and uncluttered, so young readers can see the cooking step clearly without extra people or objects beyond what the step needs.

The cooked eggs are shown ready to eat, with the focus on the finished food. The view is simple and close, so young readers can see the final step clearly without adding extra people or objects beyond what the page needs.

books.title: All Kinds of Buttons
books.art_why: Buttons are real objects that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A single round button is shown close up as the main object, with a clear circular edge and simple surface. It fills the picture so the round shape is easy to see, with nothing else in the scene.

A single square button is shown close up as the main object, with four straight sides and clear corners. It sits alone in the picture so the square shape is easy to see, with a simple surface and nothing else around it.

A single wooden button is shown close up as the main object, with a visible wood surface and simple button shape. It is the only thing in the picture, clearly made of wood, with no other objects around it.

A single metal button is shown close up as the main object, with a smooth metallic surface and simple button shape. It is the only thing in the picture, clearly made of metal, with no other objects around it.

A single dark button is shown close up as the main object, with a deep dark surface and simple button shape. It is the only thing in the picture, clearly dark in color, with no other objects around it.

A single shiny button is shown close up as the main object, with a bright reflective surface and simple button shape. It is the only thing in the picture, clearly shiny, catching light, with no other objects around it.

A single small button is shown close up as the main object, looking clearly tiny with a simple button shape. It is the only thing in the picture, placed alone so its small size is easy to see, with nothing else around it.

A single large button is shown close up as the main object, looking clearly big with a simple button shape. It is the only thing in the picture, filling the view so its large size is easy to see, with nothing else around it.

books.title: Move It!
books.art_why: Real toys that bounce, roll and float exist today and can be photographed.

pages.brief: A bright rubber ball caught in mid-air above a smooth indoor floor, just after bouncing, with a soft shadow beneath it and a plain light wall behind. The ball is the only toy in the frame, rounded and patterned, clearly shown hopping upward.

A small toy car with chunky wheels rolling across a flat wooden floor, seen from low down so the wheels and the floor are both clear. The car sits alone in the frame, tilted slightly, with a soft shadow trailing behind it as it moves.

A colourful spinning top standing on a bare tabletop, blurred at its edges to show it turning fast. The top is the only object shown, upright on its point, with the plain table surface around it and a simple background behind.

A toy dump truck on a patch of sand, its back tipped up so the sand slides out onto the ground behind it. The little truck is alone in the frame, wheels on the sand, with the tipped load clearly falling away.

A toy aeroplane held up in the air above a grassy garden, wings level, nose pointed forward as if flying. The plane is the only toy shown, high over the green grass, with open sky filling the space around it.

A toy water squirter in a shallow tub, a thin spray of water shooting from its nozzle into the air. The toy sits alone at the edge of the water, with droplets caught mid-flight against a plain background.

A small toy boat resting on the surface of calm blue water in a tub, sitting upright and steady. The boat is the only toy in the frame, with ripples spreading gently around its hull and nothing else floating nearby.

A soft toy tumbling through the air above a carpeted floor, tipped over and dropping downward, caught partway down. The toy is alone in the frame, with the empty floor below it and a plain wall behind.

books.title: Make a Salad
books.art_why: All salad ingredients and actions exist in the real world and can be photographed.

pages.brief: Fresh, crisp green lettuce leaves are being added to a large salad bowl on a clean kitchen counter. The leaves tumble gently into the bowl, filling the bottom with bright, leafy greens for a simple salad.
Thin slices of onion are being added to the salad bowl on the kitchen counter. The pale onion rings rest over the lettuce in loose layers, bringing a sharp, fresh look to the growing salad.

Sliced bell peppers are being added to the salad bowl on the kitchen counter. Bright red and green pepper strips fall onto the other ingredients, adding color and crunch to the salad as they land in the bowl.

Orange carrot slices are being added to the salad bowl on the kitchen counter. The round carrot pieces drop onto the salad, giving it a bright orange color and a crisp, firm texture as they settle into the bowl.
Chopped red tomatoes are being added to the salad bowl on the kitchen counter. Juicy tomato pieces tumble onto the other ingredients, bringing a fresh red color and a soft, wet shine to the salad.
Deep red beet slices are being added to the salad bowl on the kitchen counter. The beet pieces drop onto the salad, bringing a dark red color and a rich, earthy look as they settle in the bowl.
Small pieces of cheese are being added to the salad bowl on the kitchen counter. Pale yellow cheese cubes fall onto the salad, adding a creamy look to the colorful mix of ingredients in the bowl.

Creamy salad dressing is being poured over the salad in the bowl on the kitchen counter. The dressing flows over the ingredients in a smooth stream, coating the lettuce, onions, peppers, carrots, tomatoes, beets, and cheese.

books.title: This Lizard
books.art_why: Lizards are real animals that can be photographed today.

pages.brief: A single large lizard is shown as the main subject, with its whole body visible and clearly taking up much of the picture. Its big size is the main thing to notice about this lizard.
A single small lizard is shown as the main subject, with its whole body visible and taking up only a little space in the picture. Its small size is the main thing to notice about this lizard.
A single lizard is shown with many bright colors over its body, making it the main subject of the picture. The colors stand out clearly, and the lizard’s colorful look is the main thing to notice.
A single lizard is shown with a simple, plain look over its body, making it the main subject of the picture. It has no bright colors or busy pattern, and its plain look is the main thing to notice.

A single lizard is shown with a bumpy body, making it the main subject of the picture. The bumps cover its skin and stand out clearly, and this bumpy look is the main thing to notice about the lizard.

A single lizard is shown with smooth skin, making it the main subject of the picture. Its body looks even and unbroken, with no bumps, and this smooth look is the main thing to notice about the lizard.

A single lizard is shown with spots across its body, making it the main subject of the picture. The spots stand out clearly on its skin, and this spotted look is the main thing to notice about the lizard.

A single lizard is shown with stripes across its body, making it the main subject of the picture. The stripes stand out clearly on its skin, and this striped look is the main thing to notice about the lizard.

books.title: Hot and Cold
books.art_why: Real-world hot and cold examples are best shown in photographs.

pages.text: Things can be hot or cold.
pages.brief: A clear photographic scene showing two real things side by side: one visibly hot, with warmth or steam, and one visibly cold, with a cool, icy look. The comparison fills the frame so young readers can see that things can be hot or cold.

A wide outdoor place under strong, bright sunlight, with dry ground and a shimmering hot look in the open air. The whole place feels warm and sunbaked, with no people in view, showing that a place can be hot.
A wide outdoor place in cold weather, with pale light, frosty ground and a chill in the air. The whole place looks quiet and freezing, with no people in view, showing that a place can be cold.
A close, clear photo of hot food on a table, with visible steam rising from it. The food looks warm and ready to eat, filling the frame so young readers can see that food can be hot.
A close, clear photo of cold food on a table, with a chilled, fresh look and no steam. The food looks cool and ready to eat, filling the frame so young readers can see that food can be cold.

A real person in simple everyday clothes standing in warm light, feeling hot, with a warm face and a hand fanning themselves. Their expression and posture show they are too warm, making clear that people can be hot.

A real person in a warm jacket and scarf feeling cold, with a pale face and arms hugged close. Their shivering posture and cool surroundings show they are too cold, making clear that people can be cold.

pages.text: Things can be hot or cold.
pages.brief: A clear photographic scene showing two real things side by side again: one visibly hot and one visibly cold. The simple comparison fills the frame, closing the book by showing that things can be hot or cold.

books.title: What Lives Here?
books.art_why: Real animals and a child exist today.

pages.brief: Several animals are shown together in the place where they live. They are gathered in this shared home setting, appearing calm and natural. The scene introduces the idea that animals have a place to live here.
A bear is shown in the place where it lives. It stands or moves naturally in this home setting, filling the picture as the main subject. The scene clearly shows that this bear lives here.
A deer is shown in the place where it lives. It stands or rests naturally in this home setting, filling the picture as the main subject. The scene clearly shows that this deer lives here.

A fish is shown in the place where it lives. It swims naturally in this home setting, filling the picture as the main subject. The scene clearly shows that this fish lives here and belongs in this place.

A frog is shown in the place where it lives. It sits or rests naturally in this home setting, filling the picture as the main subject. The scene clearly shows that this frog lives here and belongs in this place.

A worm is shown in the place where it lives. It rests or moves naturally in this home setting, filling the picture as the main subject. The scene clearly shows that this worm lives here and belongs in this place.

A bee is shown in the place where it lives. It rests or flies naturally in this home setting, filling the picture as the main subject. The scene clearly shows that this bee lives here and belongs in this place.

A child is shown in the place where the child lives. The child stands or sits calmly in this home setting as the main subject. The picture clearly shows that this child lives here and belongs in this place.

books.title: Mom and I
books.art_why: Real animals and a real mother and child exist in the world today.

pages.brief: A mother lion and a small lion cub stand close together on a wide grassy savanna under a bright sky. The mother gazes ahead while the cub leans against her side, both with tawny fur and rounded ears, dry grass around their paws.

A mother elephant and her tiny calf walk slowly across a dusty plain. The mother's long trunk curls down toward the calf, which steps close beside her thick legs with its ears flapping. Dry grass and a few distant trees fill the background under warm sunlight.

A tall mother giraffe and a small baby giraffe stand among leafy trees on an open savanna. The mother stretches her long neck up to nibble leaves while the baby giraffe stays near her legs, both with spotted coats and gentle faces in soft daylight.

A mother zebra and her young foal stand together on a grassy plain. The mother's black and white stripes shine in the sun as the foal presses close to her side, both looking calmly across the open grassland toward distant hills.

A big mother bear and a small bear cub walk near the edge of a green forest. The mother's thick brown fur ruffles in the breeze while the cub follows close behind her, both moving over soft moss and fallen leaves in dappled light.

A mother ape and a baby ape sit high in a leafy jungle tree. The baby clings tightly to the mother's dark fur while she holds a branch with one long arm, green leaves all around them and warm sunlight filtering through the canopy.

A mother kangaroo stands on dry grassy ground with her small joey peeking out from her pouch. Her strong tail rests behind her and her tall ears stand up as she looks across the open landscape under a clear blue sky.

A mother dolphin and her small calf swim side by side through bright blue ocean water. The mother's smooth grey body glides near the surface while the calf stays close beside her, ripples and sunlight sparkling on the water around them.

books.title: Baby Animals
books.art_why: Real baby animals exist today and are photographed, not drawn.

pages.brief: A small kitten with soft fur and tiny paws sits close to the camera, looking straight ahead with bright round eyes and small pointed ears, its whiskers spread wide. The young cat is calm and still, shown alone, close up and filling most of the picture.

A young puppy stands facing the viewer, front paws planted, mouth slightly open and tail loose behind it. Its ears are soft and floppy, its coat short and fuzzy. The baby dog is shown alone and close up, head tilted a little, alert and friendly.

A fluffy yellow chick stands on its own, small and round, with a tiny beak and thin legs. It looks up towards the viewer, one foot lifted mid-step. The very young bird is shown alone and close up, soft down catching the light.

A young cub sits upright, sturdy and round, with thick fur, broad paws and small rounded ears. It faces the viewer with a calm, steady look. The baby wild animal is shown alone and close up, its whole body visible against a soft plain background.

A young calf stands on four long, slightly unsteady legs, looking towards the viewer. Its coat is smooth, its ears large and its muzzle soft and pale. The baby farm animal is shown alone and close up, head turned a little, standing quietly.

A young kid, a baby goat, stands with slender legs and a small pointed face, ears angled out to the sides. It looks straight at the viewer, chin lifted. The little animal is shown alone and close up, its soft coat and neat hooves visible.

A young lamb stands on small neat hooves, its coat woolly and thick, ears soft at the sides of its face. It faces the viewer with a gentle, curious look. The baby sheep is shown alone and close up against a plain background.

A young foal stands tall on long thin legs, its coat smooth and short, a short mane along its neck and big dark eyes. It faces the viewer, ears forward. The baby horse is shown alone and close up, whole body in view.

books.title: Spring Weather
books.art_why: Real weather, clouds, rain, sun and flowers can be photographed.

pages.brief: Soft gray fog drifts low and slow across the open air. It comes closer in pale waves, making the distance hazy and quiet. Nothing else is shown except the fog filling the scene around it.
Gray clouds gather and move across the sky, layer upon layer. They come together in soft, heavy shapes, making the daylight dimmer. Only the clouds and the wide sky are shown as they roll in.
Dark storm clouds fill the sky as the storm comes. The air looks heavy and tense, with deep gray clouds spreading wide. Only the coming storm and the darkening sky are shown, with no rain yet.
Rain comes down in steady lines from gray clouds. Drops fall through the air and darken the ground below. The scene shows only the falling rain, the wet ground, and the cloudy sky above as it falls.

Wind comes as visible motion in the open air, with loose air currents sweeping across the scene. The movement is strong and clear, pushing through the empty space. Only the wind and its motion are shown.
The sun comes out bright and round in the sky. Warm light spreads across the open scene, making the air glow. Only the sun and its bright light are shown, with clear sky around it.

Spring flowers come up from the ground, opening their petals in bright colors. Green stems and leaves rise around them in the soft outdoor light. Only the flowers, stems, leaves, and ground are shown as they bloom.

Spring comes with a fresh, bright outdoor scene. Soft light and new growth fill the view, showing the season arriving. Only the spring season and its fresh outdoor setting are shown, with no people or extra objects.
